## Modelling sanitation outcomes

Two outcomes modelled:

- **Basic sanitation**: household uses an improved facility (WS11 == 2) that is not shared (WS15 == 0)
- **Open defecation**: household has no facility (WS11 == 0)

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Random forest modelling for sanitation outcomes
# Reads final training datasets, adds country-level covariates,
# and uses PSU-based weights instead of household-count weights
# ============================================================
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(purrr)
library(ggplot2)
library(h2o)
library(here)
```

### 1. Prepare training datasets

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 1. Read final training datasets
# ============================================================
training_dir <- here::here("./data/training_subcomponents")

basic_sanitation_training_with_covariates <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(training_dir, "basic_sanitation_training_with_covariates.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

open_defecation_training_with_covariates <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(training_dir, "open_defecation_training_with_covariates.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
outcome_col <- "outcome_value"
weight_col  <- "n_psu_weight_scaled"
country_col <- "country_cov"
```

### 2. Modelling sanitation outcomes

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 4. Helper to create RF input data
# ============================================================
create_rf_training_data <- function(training_df, outcome_name) {

  model_features <- intersect(all_predictor_features, names(training_df))

  train_data <- training_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      model_name   = outcome_name,
      country_eval = as.character(.data[[country_col]]),
      country_fold = as.factor(as.integer(factor(country_eval))),
      model_weight = as.numeric(.data[[weight_col]])
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      dplyr::all_of(model_features),
      dplyr::all_of(outcome_col),
      model_weight,
      country_eval,
      country_fold,
      country_outcome,
      HH7_region_outcome,
      analysis_year
    ) %>%
    tidyr::drop_na(
      dplyr::all_of(outcome_col),
      model_weight,
      country_eval,
      country_fold
    )

  list(
    data         = train_data,
    features     = model_features,
    outcome_name = outcome_name
  )
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Remove Pakistan from all training datasets before modelling
# ============================================================
remove_pakistan <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      !stringr::str_detect(
        stringr::str_to_lower(country_outcome),
        "^pakistan"
      )
    )
}

basic_sanitation_training_with_covariates <- remove_pakistan(
  basic_sanitation_training_with_covariates
)

open_defecation_training_with_covariates <- remove_pakistan(
  open_defecation_training_with_covariates
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
```
```{r}
# Start H2O
# ============================================================
h2o::h2o.init(
  nthreads    = -1,
  max_mem_size = "12G"
)
h2o::h2o.no_progress()
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 7. Helper to run RF with leave-one-country-out CV
# ============================================================
run_rf_loco <- function(rf_input, ntrees = 500, seed = 123) {

  train_data    <- rf_input$data
  model_features <- rf_input$features
  outcome_name  <- rf_input$outcome_name

  train_h2o <- h2o::as.h2o(
    train_data,
    destination_frame = paste0("train_", outcome_name)
  )

  rf_model <- h2o::h2o.randomForest(
    x                                        = model_features,
    y                                        = outcome_col,
    training_frame                           = train_h2o,
    ntrees                                   = ntrees,
    mtries                                   = -1,
    sample_rate                              = 0.632,
    fold_column                              = "country_fold",
    weights_column                           = "model_weight",
    seed                                     = seed,
    keep_cross_validation_predictions        = TRUE,
    keep_cross_validation_fold_assignment    = TRUE
  )

  cv_predictions <- h2o::h2o.getFrame(
    rf_model@model$cross_validation_holdout_predictions_frame_id$name
  ) %>%
    as.data.frame()

  cv_eval <- train_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      predicted = cv_predictions$predict,
      observed  = .data[[outcome_col]]
    )

  metrics <- tibble::tibble(
    outcome_name = outcome_name,
    n_rows       = nrow(train_data),
    n_countries  = dplyr::n_distinct(train_data$country_eval),
    n_features   = length(model_features),
    xval_r2      = as.numeric(h2o::h2o.r2(rf_model,   xval = TRUE)),
    xval_mae     = as.numeric(h2o::h2o.mae(rf_model,  xval = TRUE)),
    xval_rmse    = as.numeric(h2o::h2o.rmse(rf_model, xval = TRUE))
  )

  variable_importance <- h2o::h2o.varimp(rf_model) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    dplyr::mutate(outcome_name = outcome_name)

  list(
    model               = rf_model,
    cv_eval             = cv_eval,
    metrics             = metrics,
    variable_importance = variable_importance,
    features            = model_features
  )
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# 8. Run RF models for both outcomes
# ============================================================
rf_basic_sanitation <- run_rf_loco(rf_input_basic_sanitation)
rf_open_defecation  <- run_rf_loco(rf_input_open_defecation)

rf_results <- list(
  basic_sanitation = rf_basic_sanitation,
  open_defecation  = rf_open_defecation
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Compare model performance
# ============================================================
rf_metrics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  rf_basic_sanitation$metrics,
  rf_open_defecation$metrics
)
print(rf_metrics)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Plot CV predictions coloured by ww_region
# ============================================================
plot_rf_cv_by_ww_region <- function(rf_result, training_df, plot_title) {

  ww_region_lookup <- training_df %>%
    dplyr::distinct(
      country_outcome,
      HH7_region_outcome,
      analysis_year,
      ww_region
    )

  plot_data_cv <- rf_result$cv_eval %>%
    dplyr::left_join(
      ww_region_lookup,
      by = c("country_outcome", "HH7_region_outcome", "analysis_year")
    ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      ww_region = dplyr::if_else(
        is.na(ww_region),
        "Missing ww_region",
        as.character(ww_region)
      )
    )

  ggplot2::ggplot(
    plot_data_cv,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x      = predicted,
      y      = observed,
      size   = model_weight,
      colour = ww_region
    )
  ) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(shape = 1, alpha = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 1), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
    ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    ggplot2::stat_smooth(
      se        = TRUE,
      colour    = "black",
      linewidth = 0.5,
      method    = "lm"
    ) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title  = plot_title,
      x      = "Predicted outcome proportion",
      y      = "Observed outcome proportion",
      size   = "PSU weight",
      colour = "Wastewater region"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 9)
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Helper: print and save ggplot objects as SVG
# ============================================================
if (!requireNamespace("svglite", quietly = TRUE)) {
  stop("Please install the svglite package first: install.packages('svglite')")
}

plot_output_dir <- here::here("./outputs/04_model_performance/figures")
dir.create(plot_output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

print_and_save_svg <- function(plot_obj, filename, width = 8, height = 6) {
  print(plot_obj)
  ggplot2::ggsave(
    filename = file.path(plot_output_dir, filename),
    plot     = plot_obj,
    device   = svglite::svglite,
    width    = width,
    height   = height,
    units    = "in"
  )
}
```

```{r}
auto_label_feature <- function(x) {
  x %>%
    as.character() %>%
    stringr::str_replace_all("_", " ") %>%
    stringr::str_squish()
}

label_model_features <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  mapped <- dplyr::recode(x, !!!feature_label_map, .default = NA_character_)
  dplyr::if_else(is.na(mapped), auto_label_feature(x), mapped)
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# SHAP summary plots for both RF models
# ============================================================
library(viridis)
library(forcats)

make_shap_summary_plot <- function(
    rf_result,
    outcome_name,
    y_lab,
    sample_n = 2000
) {

  shap_df <- rf_result$cv_eval %>%
    dplyr::select(dplyr::all_of(rf_result$features))

  if (nrow(shap_df) > sample_n) {
    set.seed(123)
    shap_df <- shap_df %>% dplyr::slice_sample(n = sample_n)
  }

  shap_h2o <- h2o::as.h2o(
    shap_df,
    destination_frame = paste0("shap_data_", outcome_name)
  )

  shap_summary_plot_h2o <- h2o::h2o.shap_summary_plot(
    rf_result$model,
    shap_h2o
  )

  shap_summary_plot_data <- shap_summary_plot_h2o[["data"]] %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      feature_raw = as.character(feature),
      feature     = label_model_features(feature_raw)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(feature) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(mean_abs_shap = mean(abs(contribution), na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()

  shap_plot <- shap_summary_plot_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(feature = forcats::fct_reorder(feature, mean_abs_shap)) %>%
    ggplot2::ggplot(
      ggplot2::aes(x = feature, y = contribution, colour = normalized_value)
    ) +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    ggplot2::geom_point(
      position  = h2o:::position_jitter_density(),
      alpha     = 0.5,
      size      = 1.2
    ) +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_gradientn(
      colours = viridis::viridis_pal()(9),
      breaks  = c(0, 1),
      labels  = c("low", "high"),
      limits  = c(0, 1)
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_flip() +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title  = paste("SHAP summary:", outcome_name),
      y      = y_lab,
      x      = "",
      colour = "Normalized\nfeature value"
    ) +
    ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 9)

  list(
    plot    = shap_plot,
    data    = shap_summary_plot_data,
    h2o_plot = shap_summary_plot_h2o
  )
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Create SHAP plots for both outcomes
# ============================================================
shap_basic_sanitation <- make_shap_summary_plot(
  rf_result    = rf_basic_sanitation,
  outcome_name = "basic_sanitation",
  y_lab        = "SHAP contribution to basic sanitation prediction",
  sample_n     = 2000
)

shap_open_defecation <- make_shap_summary_plot(
  rf_result    = rf_open_defecation,
  outcome_name = "open_defecation",
  y_lab        = "SHAP contribution to open defecation prediction",
  sample_n     = 2000
)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Print SHAP plots
# ============================================================
shap_basic_sanitation$plot
shap_open_defecation$plot
```
